sections.title: Letter sound en
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (эн) /ɛn/. Its main sound is heard in the word (нос) /nos/, meaning nose. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say en
paragraphs: For the first sound, press your tongue tip firmly against your upper teeth. Let air flow out through your nose with voice. For the second sound, press the middle of your tongue flat against the roof. Keep the tip low behind your bottom teeth. Touch your neck to feel your vocal cords buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules en
paragraphs: You make the hard sound /n/, that is a plain n, before hard vowels and consonants. It also sounds this way at the end of a word, as in (сон) /son/. You make the soft sound /nʲ/, that is a softened n, before soft vowels and the soft sign. You can hear this soft sound in the word (нет) /nʲet/ and the word (день) /dʲenʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes en
paragraphs: Do not pull your tongue back to the ridge behind your teeth like in no. Instead, touch your upper teeth directly. Do not insert a separate y sound when softening the consonant like in canyon. Instead, keep the sound smooth by pressing the tongue flat as you speak.
